errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically. They are actually sorted by the total height of the bars in ascending order (from lowest on the left to highest on the right).

The description fails to mention the primary organizational principle of the chart: that the bars are sorted in ascending order of their total value. The prompt explicitly asks to describe the sorting order.
